release_status: Three visual runtime fixes and the later Japanese/Chinese control-font correction are installed and author accepted. Automated/source/native activation and final Exit checks passed. Publication is not asserted.
repository_purpose: Developer source, SDK, content-authoring contracts and ModKit build workflow. HZoi production is private and optional; the separate public HZoi-Reference provides muted content-authoring examples.

packaging_and_installation.mode: Idle UI-only hot update; B1 runtime retained

author_acceptance: Latest joint pass: unchanged female O; expression-family and outfit edits, speed/pause, navigation, Exit, repeat sessions and bed behavior reported normal.

Earlier accepted cases: 35-metre spectator exit, duplicate-start toast, singing-NPC entry, queued-interaction cancellation and participant-only marker visibility with local-UI-wide bubble suppression.
Maintainer reported no apparent failures in other suggested cancellation, furniture, three-participant, framework-only and world-transition scenarios; exact variants were not all enumerated.
On 2026-11-04 the maintainer declared SceneZOI and HZoi ready for player release. This is a readiness decision, not evidence that every possible combination was tested.
2026-11-05: author reported volume controls working as expected; retained last Exit/cleanup ok/ok, 42 discovery records with zero warnings, audio setting acknowledgement ok.

2026-11-05 localization: author reported the requested Portuguese (Brazil) and Japanese language-switch, native entry/picker, panel/content-label and glyph/layout checks correct. Latest completed scene used the normal distance guard, a subsequent scene was playing normally at readback, and no new UI error record was present.

2026-11-05 visual fixes: author reported all three bugs appear fixed after the requested mood/blink, small settings hint and third-party covered-body outfit checks. Final matching session Exit and cleanup read back ok/ok; retained historical error was unchanged.

2026-11-05 CJK font follow-up: author confirmed the requested Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese navigation/Exit glyph checks are working. Matching final session Exit/cleanup was ok/ok with no new retained error; this supersedes the earlier incomplete Japanese glyph acceptance.
native_observations: Latest first/final Exit readbacks were idle/ok; final participants matched captured collision, autonomy and inheritance originals; autosave was restored.
Independent API-5 native creator/observer acceptance passed after a clean process launch with automatic Lua and declaration loading. The final suite recorded 95 assertions/checked responses.
Manual and forced-save trials exercised SDK journal recovery and furniture cleanup. Enabled and disabled autosave settings and the interval were preserved.
Current content attachment diagnostics reported zero shared-clock discrepancy during the final joint pass.

Visual-fix hot candidate: 44 declarations/zero warnings; two expression owners kept zero face replay counters during captured playback. Final state idle/ok and matching Exit/cleanup ok/ok, with no new retained error.
CJK UI-only hot update reached idle/ok with the unchanged visual-fix runtime, new UI build marker and 44 declarations/zero warnings; retained error unchanged.
After the author CJK checks, current state was idle/ok with matching final session Exit/cleanup ok/ok. The retained historical preparation error was unchanged.
known_limits: One active, controlled-initiator session with fixed membership; concurrent/NPC-autonomous sessions and predetermined watch-only sequences are outside the first release.
The manual picker accepts two or three Zois; bundled hubs require adult-compatible male/female appearance roles. Other rosters require compatible authored content.
Overhead bubbles are suppressed across the local UI, including nonparticipants; marker suppression is participant-scoped.
New facial poses, customized heads, meshes and furniture require their own fit tests. The female O was visually accepted; no new tongue asset was created or visually tested.
Furniture profiles support upright unit-scale objects with fixed placement offsets; all cosmetic variants, occupancy/menu routes and third-party combinations were not exhaustively tested.
Native mod-manager dependency enforcement/load ordering is not established by manifest declarations. SceneZOI must remain enabled for save-journal recovery.

World teardown may prevent a final event. An earlier interrupted-session record lacked a complete final acknowledgement trace; subsequent idle state, participant settings and bed release were read back separately.
